positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Orion Exploration Missions
Orion Flight Software Certified Principal Engineer & Product Owner for Command & Data Handling flight software of MPCV Exploration Missions (EM1 & EM2)
Vehicle time architect responsible for working system design of managing vehicle time for mission from launchpad to deep space operations.


Orion EFT1.
Launch support. Finale of full satelllite life cycle work from concept through verification/validation & launch. 
Command & Data Handling Flight Software CPE delegate. Involved with data & command validation & requirement verification leading up to product certification. Inherited clock synchronization software taking it through initial integration up to launch vehicle checkout.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Real time embedded software development in a multiple virtual address space multiple threaded environment using Agile scrum process.
-Prime contractor position. Worked directly with customer and sub-contractors through multiple software development phases.  
-Worked closely with customer to develop requirements, use cases and activity diagrams for the Communications and Tracking CSCI
-Utilized object-oriented analysis and design to model application and infrastructure software using IBM Rhapsody
-Object oriented analysis and design done in IBM Rhapsody. Auto code generation feature supported code structure generation while behavior was hand coded into class methods. Development done in C++ & C.
-Software owner for applications that used industry standard networking protocols. ARP, IPv4, UDP/IP, NTP, and ICMP application software. Multicast and unicast traffic.
-Software owner for fault detection, isolation and recovery software. Test to detect system faults that feed into system level fault handling.
-Performed performance analysis to decrease CPU usage and improve timing schedule for data path through module utilizing standard performance improvements. Minimize context switching, blocking API calls and software copies in application, IP driver and COTS IP stack software in order to meet timing requirements. Used IXIA traffic generator to determine maximum throughput of module.
-Integrated sub-contractor kernel and boot loader into loadable image. 
-Oversaw unit test subcontractor to manage module unit testing.

positions.title: Lecturer & Teachers Assistant
positions.description: Involved in teaching and assisting in Aerospace Engineering classes from Freshmen level up to Graduate level. e.g. Mechanics of Materials, Aerospace Structural Analysis, Numerical Analysis.
